questions.question: What did Israel demand of Samuel when he was old?
options: A temple to replace the old tabernacle
More land to settle all of their growing tribes
A war against the neighboring nations
A king to rule them like the other nations
questions.answer: A king to rule them like the other nations

questions.question: How did God view their demand for a king?
options: He was pleased they wanted order
He was indifferent to their request
They were rejecting him as their king
questions.answer: They were rejecting him as their king

questions.question: Samuel warned them of the burdens a king would place on them.
The people asked for a _____ to judge them like all the other nations.
Samuel warned that a king would take a _____ of their flocks and harvest.
